responsibility: Provides the scheduling description for IBM POWER4 and closely related PowerPC 970-class processors. It declares the POWER4 dispatch, integer, floating-point, load/store, branch, CR, and vector/permute resources and maps rs6000 instruction attributes to reservation and bypass rules, making this the backend timing model used to schedule both classic scalar code and VMX operations for this early POWER4-generation microarchitecture family.
